user_story.summary: Catalog Page Load - Display all navigation elements, product cards, tabs, and scroll
user_story.want: the Catalog page to load completely with a search bar, all filter dropdowns, product cards, All Products/Requested tabs, and smooth scrolling
user_story.benefit: I can immediately browse and find products without any missing UI elements or broken navigation
acceptance_criteria: Search bar is visible and accepts text input
All 4 primary filters are visible (Super Category, Brand, SKU Status, Sort)
At least one product card is displayed
All Products and Requested tabs are visible and toggle correctly
Page scrolls smoothly without losing product cards
No error toasts or blank screens appear during page load

test_steps.expected: Catalog page loads with search bar visible
Super Category, Brand, SKU Status, Sort dropdowns visible
At least one product card with action button

test_steps.action: Click Requested tab then All Products tab

user_story.summary: Catalog Search - Real-time keyword filtering of products
user_story.want: to type a keyword in the search bar and see products filter in real-time
user_story.benefit: I can quickly find specific products without waiting for a search button click
acceptance_criteria: Search bar accepts text input
Product list updates in real-time as user types
Filtered results persist while scrolling
No page errors during or after search

test_steps.action: Verify results changed from initial list
test_steps.expected: Product list is different from unfiltered

test_steps.action: Scroll down and up through filtered results

user_story.summary: Super Category Filter - Dropdown with search that filters products by category
user_story.want: to open the Super Category dropdown, search for a specific category, and see products filter accordingly
user_story.benefit: I can narrow down products to a specific category instead of browsing the entire catalog
acceptance_criteria: Super Category dropdown opens on click
Internal search input appears inside the dropdown
Typing filters category options
Selecting a category filters the product list

user_story.summary: Brand, SKU Status, and Sort Filters - All three dropdowns open, show options, and filter/sort products
user_story.want: to filter products by brand, SKU status, and sort order using the respective dropdowns
user_story.benefit: I can combine multiple filters to find exactly the products I need
acceptance_criteria: Brand dropdown opens with internal search, selecting filters products
SKU Status shows Available, Already Listed, Requested, Incomplete options
Sort dropdown shows Popular, Recently Added, Name A-Z options
No errors after applying any filter

test_steps.action: Open Brand dropdown, search, select a brand
Open SKU Status filter, verify all 4 options, select Available
Open Sort dropdown, verify options, select Name A-Z

user_story.summary: More Section Filters - Category and Packing Size dropdowns revealed by More button
user_story.want: to click the More button to reveal additional filters (Category and Packing Size) and use them to narrow products
user_story.benefit: I can use additional filters when the primary ones aren't enough to find what I need
acceptance_criteria: More button reveals Category and Packing Size dropdowns
Category dropdown has internal search and filters products
Packing Size dropdown has internal search and filters products

test_steps.expected: Category and Packing Size dropdowns appear

test_steps.action: Open Category dropdown, search, select option
Open Packing Size dropdown, search, select option

user_story.summary: Product Card Types - All 5 card types render with correct actions
user_story.want: to see different product card types based on product state, each with the correct action button
user_story.benefit: I can tell at a glance what state each product is in and what actions are available
acceptance_criteria: Addable (+) cards open Add Product modal on click
Manage Listing cards open Edit Product modal with HSN/MRP fields
Incomplete cards show Request Product button and open modal with HSN/Price fields
Requested cards show Requested badge
Blocked/OOS cards show appropriate status text

test_steps.action: Find Manage Listing card and click
test_steps.expected: Edit Product modal opens with HSN/MRP

test_steps.action: Find Incomplete card and click Request Product
test_steps.expected: Modal opens with HSN Code and Your Price fields

user_story.summary: Request Product Flow - Open modal, verify fields, fill all data, submit successfully
user_story.want: to request a product by filling in all required information (dimensions, HSN, image, pricing, expiry) in a single modal
user_story.benefit: I can submit a complete product request without missing any required information
acceptance_criteria: Request Product modal opens with all required fields
All fields from PRD are present: Master Pack, Dead Weight, L/B/H, HSN, Image, MRP, Your Price, Expiry, In Stock
Filling all mandatory fields enables the submit button
Submission succeeds with success toast or modal closes

test_steps.action: Click Request Product on an incomplete card

test_steps.expected: Master Pack, Dead Weight, L/B/H, HSN, Image, Price, Your Price, Expiry, In Stock, Submit button

test_steps.action: Fill L, B, H dimensions, HSN Code, upload image, MRP, Your Price, set expiry

user_story.summary: Incorrect Product Flow - Report incorrect product details via modal
user_story.want: to report an incorrect product by selecting the issue type, adding a comment, and submitting
user_story.benefit: I can flag incorrect product information so it gets corrected for all sellers
acceptance_criteria: Incorrect? link opens the Incorrect Product modal
Modal contains issue type dropdown, comment textarea, and Request Change button
Selecting an issue type and adding comment enables the submit button
Submission succeeds with success toast

test_steps.action: Click Incorrect? on a product card

test_steps.expected: Issue dropdown, comment textarea, Request Change button visible

test_steps.action: Select issue type, add comment, submit
Verify no page errors after submission

user_story.summary: Request Variant Flow - Request a product variant with pre-filled parent data
user_story.want: to request a variant of an existing product and see the form pre-filled with parent product data
user_story.benefit: I can quickly request a variant without re-entering all the product information from scratch
acceptance_criteria: Request Variant link opens a modal
Modal contains input fields for variant details
At least some fields are pre-filled from the parent product
Modal can be closed without submitting

test_steps.action: Click Request Variant on a product card
Verify at least one field is pre-filled
test_steps.expected: At least one input has a value from parent product

user_story.summary: Create New Product Flow - Request a completely new product not in catalog
user_story.want: to create a new product that doesn't exist in the catalog by filling in all required details
user_story.benefit: I can sell products that aren't yet in the Agrim catalog by submitting a new product request
acceptance_criteria: 'Could not find your product?' section appears after scrolling
Clicking Create New Product opens a modal
Modal contains all required fields: Brand, Product Name, Packing, HSN, MRP, Your Price
Modal can be closed without submitting

test_steps.action: Scroll down to find 'Could not find your product?' section
test_steps.expected: Section found with Create New Product button
Brand, Product Name, Packing, HSN, MRP, Your Price visible
